Bug_Title: NP: Method call passes null for non-null parameter (NP_NULL_PARAM_DEREF_ALL_TARGETS_DANGEROUS)
Bug_Details:
A possibly-null value is passed at a call site where all known
  target methods require the parameter to be non-null.
Either the parameter is annotated as a parameter that should
always be non-null, or analysis has shown that it will always be
dereferenced.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by passing a null value to the method 'processString' which expects a non-null parameter. The method 'processString' attempts to call 'toUpperCase()' on the null string, leading to a NullPointerException.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method with a null parameter, which triggers the bug by passing null to the processString method. This results in a NullPointerException when processString attempts to call toUpperCase() on the null string.
